title: Services Spotlight: six layouts and doors from each kit's functions
detail:
Plan step 7a: Stack, Card wall, Story, Calendar first, Shop front, Profile, registered as services-kit:* beside network-kit-layouts. Every pin a theme addition trips (layouts none-for-others, CONTRACT_THEME_IDS) is batched into one phrase ask.

Six New World (Services) Spotlight layouts and kit doors built as standalone modules (services-kit-layouts.tsx, services-kit-layouts-css.ts, lib/spotlight/services-kit-content.ts, revision 2 kits). Not registered: layouts.ts, theme.ts and spotlight-shell wait for LIVE-2040, whose pinned tests need Daniel's phrases. Photos are the owner's or the theme gradient; live pages pass sample:false.

verify.cmd: node scripts/probes/services-theme.mjs spotlight && pnpm vitest run components/spotlight/services-kit-layouts.test.tsx
